articles.title: Live coverage: SpaceX to launch first West Coast Starlink mission of 2026
articles.summary: The Starlink 17-30 mission will send the batch of satellites into a polar low Earth orbit. Liftoff of the Falcon 9 rocket from pad 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base is set for 6:46 p.m. PST (9:46 p.m. EST / 0246 UTC).
